name: Mykonos Riviera Hotel & Spa
insider_take: This boutique haven sits perfectly positioned above Tourlos Bay, offering breathtaking sunset views over the Aegean Sea while being just minutes from Mykonos Town's legendary nightlife and Little Venice.
whats_special: The hotel features traditional Cycladic architecture with modern luxury touches, including a stunning infinity pool that seems to merge with the sea horizon. Its spa incorporates ancient Greek wellness rituals using local herbs and olive oil. The property is built on a hillside that was once part of an ancient marble quarrying route, and guests can still spot remnants of old pathways carved into the rock.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the hotel's terrace restaurant – the view rivals the famous sunset at Oia in Santorini, but without the crowds. The golden hour here is absolutely magical for photos.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary shuttle to Mykonos Town (just 5 minutes away) to explore the iconic windmills and maze-like streets. The nearby Tourlos Marina is where mega-yachts dock, making it perfect for celebrity spotting. Also, the hotel's private beach access leads to a secluded cove that most tourists never discover.
pros: Luxurious spa facilities with authentic Greek wellness treatments
Stunning Aegean Sea views from most accommodations
Prime Mykonos location with easy access to beaches and town
Elegant Cycladic architecture with modern amenities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Mykonos properties
Seasonal operation with limited winter availability
